learning_curve_selection.rule: Same fixed seed for both variants and model families; no best-test selection.

commands.train: python scripts/experiments/reproduce.py --stage all --device auto --wandb_mode disabled --output_dir outputs/reproduce

limitations: AP is scikit-learn average precision. Five-seed error bars are sample standard deviations of training runs on the same previously consulted Kepler split; they are not confidence intervals. Metadata comparisons change both inputs and model capacity. Model families use different training recipes and precision modes, so their comparison is descriptive. These experiments do not measure TESS transfer.
